name: labs/slietar__nikon
title: Nikon Ti2-E microscope (nikon.microscope:MicroscopeDevice)
intro: Nikon Ti2-E microscope (nikon.microscope:MicroscopeDevice), adapted from slietar/nikon. It reads `firmware_version` and `zoom`; sets `x`, `y`, `z`, `condenser` and 6 more. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/slietar__nikon --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/slietar__nikon --backend fake --mcp
